accepted_warns.match: tilt servo out +X through the right post
accepted_warns.why: v2-A3 finish (A2 slide 0.10): the 0.10 is at rest (slide step 0), from the tips of the four FST_tilt_horn_* M2 x 8 (x 45.5, 0.2 past the adapter's -X face) to the journal plate's counterbore floor (x 45.4). Both ride PIV_tilt, keyed together, so there is no relative axial motion, and the slide moves the tips away. After that the closest pair is the 12 AF key in its 12.3 AF socket, 0.15 per flat for 6.5 mm (vertex probe of the slide: 0.15 at 0..5 mm, 0.72 at 7, nothing within 3 mm from 10). It is not the 0.3 servo clamp pocket in post_R, so opening that pocket would change nothing, and opening the socket would add tilt backlash

config._about: v2 checks. Every geometric v1 review issue has a row here; the id in each 'why' points into ../renders/attempt-N/review.md (A1-#n, A2-#n, A3-Xn). Object names follow DESIGN_LOG.md 'v2 naming'. distances.a/b are exact names. Attempt 2: rows tagged v2-A1-NN close issues from ../renders/attempt-1/review.md. PIV_hood values in rows: +1.315 = gap 5.3 (printed min-gap stop, HOOD_HI), -0.558 = gap 7.0 (thumbwheel stop-sleeve static max); keep them in sync with params.solve_eps if NIP_SET changes. Attempt 3: rows tagged v2-A2-NN close issues from ../renders/attempt-2/review.md. NEW PIV_hood values: +0.327 = gap 6.2 (HOOD_GAP_MIN raised 5.3 -> 6.2 for A2-01, printed min-gap stop, HOOD_HI), -0.558 = gap 7.0 (static max, unchanged); PIV_nip_lift -1.493 = the leaf stack goes solid against the cover roof (LEAF_PAD_H + LEAF_T = 4.5 between thumbwheel and roof). Nip rays are framed in PIV_hood (A2-04: the PIV_tilt-framed y37 ray slipped past the hood lip at full lift).

assembly_order.step: 1 base shell upside down: adapter into its fence, M3 x 20 self-tappers from the deck top
1a pan drive on the bench: horn screwed into the pinion recess
1b pan drive on the bench: servo into the pocket + clamp, pinion onto the spline, centre screw through the pinion
1c pan drive onto the deck posts
2a floor plate on the bench: partition, MotorGo on its standoffs
2b floor plate on the bench: buck, servo controller
2c turntable on the bench: groove cap, posts from the turntable underside
2d thrust ring on the hub, turntable assembly into the deck hole; hub gear meshed under the deck and screwed up into the hub (floor still off)
3 floor into the shell, cables; v2-A2-02 launcher base lead (phase + encoder) from the MotorGo to the hub with its U-loop under the hub gear
6a pod on the bench: motor into the nacelle bore (crush ribs), body onto the nacelle plate; motor + nacelle screws from inside the guard; phase leads into the journal bore
6b magnet glued on the rear shaft with the jig (spigot in the 8 mm access hole); Plink on the cap pegs; encoder cap into the bore
6c hex stud head dropped into the backplate pocket (captive hex, never driven); v2-A1-01 nip stop pad into its pocket under the muzzle floor, 1 x M3 x 6 up from the skin
6d backplate into its bay, journal plate on (3 csk), hinge axle through wall + boss + plate into its trapped nut
6e stop sleeve over the stud, thumbwheel onto the stud (set the gap), leaf screwed under the nip cover from outside, cover onto the land
6f flywheel onto the D-shaft, two pinch bolts through their nuts (L-key from +X)
6g wheel-side cover (4 csk)
7 pod drops into the post U-slots, held nose-up about 20 deg (v2-A1-06)
8a tilt drive on the bench: horn screwed to the adapter
8b tilt drive on the bench: adapter + horn onto the servo spline, centre screw through the 6.5 key hole
8 tilt servo + horn adapter slide in -X through the right post (key into the journal-plate socket), cover
9 beam closes the journal U-slots
10a feeder drive on the bench: horn screwed into the pinion recess (M2 x 8)
10b crown upside down: pinion + horn in from below; then servo #3 into its pocket from the top, spline pressed into the horn (v2-A1-04: no centre screw; the lobe cover in 10d holds the servo down)
10c disc in from below (band meshes with the pinion), floor plate on with 2 csk from below
10d feeder upright: bus into the channel, servo cover (2 csk)
11 feeder onto the beam

12 jar on the bench: adapter in the band, gate laid closed on the valve floor (stop lug up), valve onto the spout (the spout tip captures the lug; v2-A1-09); v2-A2-A1-09 detent clip screwed on the +Y cheek, bump dropped into the closed notch
13 jar onto the feeder: drop in at +30, twist to 0
14 battery slides onto the adapter rail +X -> -X (last; BOM step 14)
